description: Near-shell fast-evaluator wall for the pre-fix base 68b7554 and the final hybrid default 69bfd77 at 64^3 output, R=3 cells, tile 4, 2000 sources at the grid centre (6,144,000 source-node pairs), on a rosi_v100 Tesla V100-SXM2-32GB device and the same node's 48-core CPU.

host.cpu: rosi_v100 (gv001), 48-core CPU, Release build, no CUDA link

protocol.device: 2 warm-up + 7 timed runs, median, serial, idle GPU
protocol.host: interleaved base/default A/B, 2 warm-up pairs + 5 timed pairs, median

notes: The default rows select the observer-cell reach explicitly (--exact-cells 0); the automatic sentinel resolves to the same reach at tolerance 1e-3, and a gamma>=100 tile resolves to full support. CPU default/base is 0.91-0.96x, GPU on-node 1.006-1.009x, GPU 12-cell cloud 1.16-1.30x. The former all-exact intermediate cost penalty is retracted; the observer-cell default pays no such penalty.
